I am an old man now, 57 years, and I have been farming this land in Amhara all my life. This maize plot is small, only half a hectare close to the house, so I will put my manure from the cattle here because it is near and easy to carry. I will buy some DAP and urea from the cooperative like last year if the price is not too high, but not too much because fertilizer is expensive and the rains can fail. I will use the improved maize seed the extension worker brings because it gives more grain, and my wife and sons will help me weed twice — I do not need to hire much labor for such a small plot, maybe only a few days at weeding time when the grass is strong.
